==Notes==
*Despite being listed as a multiplier, it will stack '''additively''' with other sources of Damage to Orokin.
**For example, combining {{WF|Rhino}}'s {{A|Roar}} (+50% faction damage bonus to all factions) and a max rank Cleanse Orokin with x1.3 Damage to Corrupted grants a '''1 + 0.5 + 0.3 = x1.8''' multiplier for damage against Corrupted.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|36}}
*Changed the name of “Bane of Corrupted” Mods to “Bane of Orokin” to match their new faction name that was released with the Resistances and Status Rework in the Jade Shadows update.

{{ver|34.0}}
*Changed the Faction Damage Mod (includes Bane, Cleanse, Expel, Smite, Railjack, and Riven Faction Stats) descriptions to use multiplier instead of percentage based stat formatting. Damage values have not changed! Just the way they are communicated.
**For example: Smite Corpus (at max rank)
***Was: “+30% Damage to Corpus.”
***Now: “x1.3 Damage to Corpus.”
**This change better communicates how Faction Damage is calculated, since calculation occurs when you hit the enemy, as opposed to when you shoot like other damage sources (since it needs to know what Faction is being hit). For that reason, multipliers apply to final damage as a whole and not just part of the formula!

{{ver|21}}
*Introduced.
}}

*{{M|Bane of Orokin}}, the rifle equivalent of this mod.
*{{M|Expel Orokin}}, the secondary equivalent of this mod.
*{{M|Smite Orokin}}, the melee equivalent of this mod.

'''Clip Delegation''' is a [[Weapon Augments|Weapon Augment Mod]] exclusive to the {{Weapon|Sobek}} and {{Weapon|Kuva Sobek}} that, on reload, increases the next magazine's [[Status Effect|Status Chance]] and [[Multishot]] per shot landed with the current magazine, to a maximum of 15 stacks at all mod ranks.

==Acquisition==
*Available for {{Nc|20}} from the [[Nightwave#Cred%20Offerings|Nightwave Cred Offerings]] store on a rotational basis.
*Clip Delegation was originally acquired by reaching Rank 15 in [[Nightwave]] during [[Nightwave/Nora's Mix Volume 6|Nora's Mix Volume 6]].
**Beginning with [[Nightwave]] [[Nightwave/Nora's Mix: Dreams of the Dead|Nora’s Mix: Dreams of the Dead]], it was added to the Nightwave Cred Offerings.

==Notes==
*Stacks only considers per trigger pull. Individual pellets from [[Multishot]] or [[Punch Through]] hitting multiple targets do '''not''' grant additional stacks.
*Reload from [[Holster]] effects only apply to the first reloaded tick. Subsequent ticks will then remove all stacks. The same applies to Cyte-09's '''[[Resupply]].'''
*For {{M|Acid Shells}} builds, the increased Multishot and Status Chance will make the initial target easier to kill, but will have no effect on the area of effect explosions.

==Tips==
*Increasing [[Magazine Size]] or [[Ammo Efficiency]] allows more available shots before reloading.
**[[Primary Crux]] would be a beneficial partner for this reason; it adds yet more Status Chance and Ammo Efficiency when an enemy's weakpoint is struck.

{{Codex|Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte Coda infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire  at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.}}
'''Coda Bassocyst''' is a unique [[Coda]] boombox [[shotgun]] that shoots wide sonic projectiles. Its [[Alternate Fire]] launches an Infested mite that latches onto enemy heads to inflict {{D|Impact}} and {{D|Magnetic}} status effects, while an enemy opened to a [[Parazon]] Mercy Finisher will perform a teleporting execution that strengthens damage and [[multishot]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Blast}} damage.
*Performing a Mercy Kill grants '''+100%''' damage and [[Multishot]] for '''20''' seconds.
*Primary Fire:
**Innate [[Infinite Body Punch Through]].
**Projectiles have a thickness of '''?''' meters.
*[[Alternate Fire]]:
**Launches a mite that latches up to 6 enemies, highlighting their heads for '''5''' seconds while dealing {{D|Impact}} and {{D|Magnetic}} damage and status effects per second for '''10''' seconds.
***Consumes 4 ammo per shot.
***Does not benefit from [[Multishot]], neither in terms of total damage nor the number of hit enemies.
***Has a large auto-aim cone (~90 degrees).
***Does not trigger headshot conditions and does not benefit from headshot multipliers.
**If the target is opened to a [[Parazon|Mercy]], the user will instead teleport to them and automatically perform a Mercy Finisher.
***Bonuses stack additively with respective mods.
***Buff duration is refreshed on Mercy kills.
***Mercy Finisher needs a target under the teeth reticle, so to avoid unwanted teleports aiming above or below a target is a workaround.
**Cannot be used without a target that is within 25 meters.
***[[Projectile Speed]] mods like {{M|Fatal Acceleration}}, {{M|Galvanized Acceleration}} will extend this range.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] and [[Tenet]] weapons directly acquired from a [[Kuva Lich]] or [[Sisters of Parvos]], the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

{{Advantages|class=Shotgun|
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun|
*Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 35m to 60m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]).
}}

{{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Coda Acquisition}}

==Known Bugs==
*{{M|Galvanized Savvy}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hit, and does not affect the damage of the alt-fire.
*Alt-fire doesn't interrupt {{A|Prowl}}.
*Alt-fire does not benefit from {{A|Toxic Lash}}, {{A|Resupply}}, {{A|Seeking Talons}}, {{M|Jet Stream}} or {{WF|Koumei}}'s passive.
**Universal weapon buffs such as {{A|Xata's Whisper}}, {{A|Nourish}}, {{M|Valence Formation}}, {{M|Shock Trooper}}, {{M|Anabolic Pollination}} or {{Arcane|Theorem Demulcent}} do apply, with these buffs applying retroactively to mites already on targets.
**Does not benefit from the damage multiplier of {{A|Breach Surge}}, but does trigger sparks.
**Every tick by the mite is affected by {{A|Ballistic Battery}} and {{A|Navigator}}, however only one mite will be affected.
**Does not benefit from {{A|Electric Shield}}, although this is likely due to not interacting with barriers, mentioned below in [[Coda_Bassocyst#Tips]].
*Mods or Arcanes that activate when a status effect is applied by a weapon (such as {{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, {{Arcane|Primary Exhilarate}}, {{M|Shivering Contagion}} or {{M|Magnetic Welt}}) do not trigger from status effects applied by the alt-fire.
**Currently {{Arcane|Primary Obstruct}} and {{Arcane|Primary Debilitate}} are exceptions to this, working as intended with both forced and random statuses.
**Status effects from {{Arcane|Primary Debilitate}} will still activate {{M|Shivering Contagion}} as expected, as well as relevant arcanes on archguns.
*If target dies or otherwise becomes an invalid target immediately before alt-fire would trigger a Mercy Finisher, the player teleports to the target without performing a Mercy Finisher.
**Ragdolled enemies (such as those in {{A|Strangledome}}) are valid for teleporting to but invalid for Mercy Finishers, allowing repeated teleports to the same target.

==Tips==
*Has a unique buff lasting 20 seconds when a mercy kill is completed, granting 100% damage additive to mods such as {{M|Serration}} and 100% additional multishot. This buff can be triggered with either the Coda Bassocyst's alternate fire execution, or doing a normal mercy kill without switching to it.
*Alt-Fire ignores barriers created by Nullifier units and Arctic/Frozen/Cryonic Eximus units, but not the barriers around Guardian Eximus units. However, the projectiles can pass through a barrier from a Guardian Eximus to reach a different unit.
*Alt-fire does not damage the body part the mite attaches to, instead damaging similarly to an ability. This is most visible when using {{A|Xata's Whisper}}, resulting in bullet attractors typically on the lower torso or between the feet of the target.
*Teleport from alt-fire can often fail to teleport, especially when enemies are on uneven ground or near walls. This is likely from failing to find a valid position to teleport the player, thus making this ability much less effective on certain tilesets.

==Trivia==
*Has a unique reticle featuring "teeth."
*The primary fire and alt fire have a base damage of 808 and 303 respectively. These are likely references to the Roland [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roland_TR-808 TR-808] drum machine and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roland_TB-303 TB-303] bass synthesizer.
*The magazine size and maximum ammo of 24 and 96 are likely references to audio as well. 24-bit, 96 kHz audio files, commonly referred to as 24/96, are among the most commonly distributed high-resolution audio formats.
*The Coda Bassocyst's reload, like all Coda weapons, has a unique animation. Upon reloading, the Warframe feeds the gun by inserting more ammo into the gun's barrel, which it then 'eats' while the Warframe shakes their hand clean.

'''Coda Sporothrix''' is the [[Coda]] variant of the Infested {{Weapon|Sporothrix}} explosive sniper rifle, sporting improvements to its already high damage and [[status chance]], along with increased [[critical chance]], [[magazine size]], faster [[reload speed]], and explosion radius.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*One zoom mode that has 2.7x zoom distance and +50% headshot damage.
*Shots explode in a '''2''' meter [[AoE]] radius after '''0.9''' seconds on impacting a surface or enemy.
**Explosion deals innate {{D|Viral}} damage.
**Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting [[Stagger|self-stagger]], but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the projectile.
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Explosion does not affect combo counter.
*Can use the Sporothrix-exclusive {{M|Volatile Variant}} [[Weapon Augments#Weapon Augment Mods|Weapon Augment Mod]].
*Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}.
*Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] and [[Tenet]] weapons directly acquired from a [[Kuva Lich]] or [[Sisters of Parvos]], the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

==Tips==
*Despite being a sniper rifle primarily intended against single targets, the exploding barbs make Sporothrix equally valuable as a crowd control weapon. Aiming at grouped enemies is a good way of maximizing the weapon's effectiveness.
*There are several ways to make use of the Sporothrix's high critical damage by adding flat critical chance bonuses:
**{{D|Puncture}} status adding up to 25% flat critical chance at 5 stacks.
***This does not apply to area effect damage.
**{{Companion|Adarza Kavat}} {{M|Cat's Eye}} periodically grants an additive 60% boost to critical chance.
**{{Companion|Smeeta Kavat}}'s {{M|Charm}} periodically grants a fixed 200% critical chance as one of its possible effects.
**With another player using the {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}}'s [[Alternate Fire]], shooting through the orb adds a flat +25% critical chance, in addition to +25% critical damage and extra {{D|Electricity}}.
**{{WF|Harrow}}'s {{A|Covenant}} can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage.
**A fully ranked {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}} has a 21% chance upon receiving damage to grant +45% flat critical chance.
**{{WF|Mesa}}'s {{M|Ballistic Bullseye}} allows for a single bullet and subsequent explosion to gain an additive critical chance bonus, scaling with [[Ability Strength]].
**{{WF|Citrine}}'s {{A|Crystallize}} spawns a large crystal growth on enemies, shooting the growth inflicts a fixed 300% critical chance.
**{{WF|Sevagoth}}'s {{M|Shadow Haze}} adds a flat +50% additive critical chance when attacking enemies inflicted with{{A|Reap}} or {{A|Death's Harvest}}.
**{{WF|Temple}}'s {{A|Overdrive}} adds a flat +25% additive critical chance (this value is doubled when cast on the backbeat) on enemies affected by it (value scales with [[Ability Strength]]).

'''Coda Catabolyst''' is the [[Coda]] variant of the Infested {{Weapon|Catabolyst}} laser pistol with a grenade-like ammo sac. In addition to enhanced damage, [[status chance]], and [[magazine size]], the reload grenade now throws three grenades but at a smaller explosion radius.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Corrosive}} damage.
*Primary beam:
**Has linear damage falloff from '''100%''' to '''1.88%''' from 9m to 19m target distance. Distance is affected by [[Projectile Speed]], but it doesn't increase the maximum range of the beam.
**Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
**Damage ramps up from 20% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 20% over 2 seconds.
**The zone of impact or maximum beam range has a spherical blast radius of '''0.7''' meters, bringing up the total range to 19.7 meters before mods, allowing it to hit multiple enemies at once.
***Radial damage is not affected by [[multishot]].
***Radius is affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
*Reload throws '''3''' grenades at a 45 degree angle towards the reticle that explodes in '''3''' - '''5''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy.
**Damage, [[critical chance]], status chance, and explosion range increase when reloading with no ammo in the magazine.
**Reload from empty has an innate '''-20%''' [[Reload|Reload Speed]] buff applied to it's base reload time of '''1.7''' seconds, increasing the time it takes to reload to '''2.125''' seconds.
***Bonus is additive with {{M|Quickdraw}} and similar bonuses.
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Projectile speed is '''not''' affected by {{M|Lethal Momentum}} .
**Weapon must be completely emptied from a full magazine in order maximize the use of the grenades.
**Radius is '''not''' affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
**Grenades are thrown mid-reload, interrupting the reload (e.g. with [[Self-stagger]], or a [[Melee]] attack) will let you throw them again ad infinitum.
*Can equip the Catabolyst-exclusive {{M|Critical Mutation}} mod.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus damage (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] and [[Tenet]] weapons directly acquired from a [[Kuva Lich]] or [[Sisters of Parvos]], the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

**Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.

'''Coda Tysis''' is the [[Coda]] variant of the Infested {{Weapon|Tysis}} dart pistol, with drastic improvements to its poor [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]], along with enhanced damage and [[magazine size]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Corrosive}} damage.
*On kill, bodies will follow the dart that killed them, damaging anyone in their path and pinning the corpse to walls.
*Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] and [[Tenet]] weapons directly acquired from a [[Kuva Lich]] or [[Sisters of Parvos]], the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

{{Advantages|
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Projectiles have travel time.
*Fairly high recoil.
}}
{{WeaponComparison|Tysis}}

==Acquisition==
{{Transclude|Lich System/Weapons#Coda Acquisition}}

==Notes==
*The 177 {{D|Corrosive}} damage is dealt in 3 ticks of 59 damage over the course of 2 seconds. This allows a single dart to proc multiple times.
**Each multishot creates DoT individually.
**If the dart [[Punch Through|punches through]] an enemy, they will instead receive 1 tick. The dart also explodes with a small radius if it hits a wall or the floor; all enemies touched by the explosion receive the full DoT.
*Coda Tysis needles retain their course after piercing their first target, possibly penetrating multiple targets without losing accuracy.
*Coda Tysis needles will be invisible if the energy color is Black, making target leading harder as you can't estimate travel speed and deviation effectively.
*The progenitor bonus is applied separately to the dart impact and the DoT effect, using the relative base damage of each attack.
*Similar to the Tysis, the Coda Tysis in-game arsenal is incorrect and contains a UI bug.
**The codex indicates a single attack containing 18 {{D|Impact}}, 32 {{D|Puncture}}, 26 {{D|Slash}}, and 59 {{D|Corrosive}} damage with an unspecified DoT effect and ignores the progenitor bonus. In truth, the primary projectile attack only uses the specified physical damage types and values and the DoT effect only uses the stated {{D|Corrosive}} damage. As such, the base damage listed in the in-game codex (135) is incorrect as it is split between the two attacks (76 and 59, respectively).
**The arsenal screen includes the progenitor bonus causing a potential UI bug. The first Coda Tysis available from [[Eleanor]] includes an {{D|Impact}} progenitor bonus. As such, additional impact damage is added to the dart and the DoT effect. However, the progenitor bonus of the DoT effect overwrites all other sources of {{D|Impact}} in the arsenal screen. Testing indicates Coda Tysis is performing as expected, but the arsenal screen is underreporting the amount of damage inflicted.
**It is not currently known how this will look like with a non-{{D|Impact}} progenitor bonus. If the pattern holds, the arsenal is likely to indicate only the progenitor damage added to the DoT, ignoring the progenitor damage added to the dart itself.

'''Coda Bubonico''' is the [[Coda]] variant of the Infested {{Weapon|Bubonico}} arm-cannon, sporting increased [[Critical Chance|critical chance]], [[Status Chance|status chance]], [[fire rate]], and increased [[magazine size]], but possess a brief spool-up to achieve optimal fire rate.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage and innate {{D|Toxin}} on its primary fire and {{D|Viral}} on its [[Alternate Fire]].
*Primary fire shoots 7 pellet barrages in a fully automatic fashion.
*Requires a spool-up of '''7''' shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
**Fire rate starts at '''30%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''11.67%''' per shot.
*Alternate fires a three round burst that explode in a '''7''' meter radius upon impact with a surface or enemy.
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
*This weapon does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
** Has a '''1.5''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''9''' ammo per second; takes '''4''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay. This delay is affected by [[Reload Speed]].
*** If the magazine is completely emptied, the reload delay is shortened to '''0.1''' seconds.
**Does not benefit from mods that increase [[Ammo#Ammo%20Maximum|maximum ammo]], due to lack of an ammo pool.
*Innate two {{Pol|Naramon}} and one {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike [[Kuva (Variant)|Kuva]] and [[Tenet]] weapons directly acquired from a [[Kuva Lich]] or [[Sisters of Parvos]], the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

{{Advantages|class=Shotgun|
*Primary Fire:
**Innate punch through allows hitting multiple targets in line.
**High [[accuracy]].
*Alternate Fire:
**Pinpoint accuracy.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun|
*Primary Fire:
**Projectiles have travel time.
*Alternate Fire:
**Multiplied consumption results in only three bursts before recharging.
**Slow projectiles have travel time with heavy arcing.
**Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
***Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
**Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from central impact.
}}

== Notes ==

* The [[Coda Bubonico]] uses [[Shotgun Mods]].
* Primary fire has 1.9 meters of [[Punch Through]].
* Alternate fire explosion has a '''7''' meter area of effect.
** Each shot in the burst consumes 3 rounds (9 rounds per burst).
** Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
** Explosion has an innate '''+9s''' [[Status Duration]] bonus.
*** Bonus is applied '''before''' other percentage sources of status duration.
** Explosion does not need direct [[Line of Sight]] to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
** Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% over 7m.
* Reload has a '''1.5''' second delay before ammo begins to regenerate. Ammo regenerates at '''9''' ammo per second; taking '''4''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay.
** If the magazine is completely emptied, the reload delay is shortened to '''0.1''' seconds.
* It is officially classified as a [[Launcher]] and cannot be used in missions with Shotgun-Only restrictions.

== Known Bugs ==

* {{M|Galvanized Savvy}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.
* {{M|Handspring}} and {{M|Constitution}} have no effect on the knockdown caused by Bubonico's alternate fire.

* Whenever Coda Bubonico is regenerating its ammo, a looped sound of tape rewinding can be heard.
